name: Claude Code Extensions
headline: explore claude code extensions and plugins
short_description: Claude Code Extensions provides a collection of custom plugins for Claude Code, enabling automation of tasks like diagramming and code generation. Operations teams can streamline workflows by integrating these plugins into their development processes.
author: johnlarkin1

sections.overview:
Claude Code Extensions provides a modular set of plugins and skills for Claude Code, including diagram generation (Mermaid, GraphViz, Excalidraw), mathematical animations (ManimCE), Tauri desktop app development, and Python Textual TUI frameworks. Users can install individual plugins through the Claude marketplace or copy standalone skills to their local Claude configuration. The collection also includes specialized agents for domain-specific tasks like diagram planning, animation sequencing, and code review, plus CLI tools that extend Claude's command-line capabilities with additional flags.
Generate documentation diagrams and architecture visualizations in multiple formats
Create mathematical animations for educational or technical content
Develop cross-platform desktop applications using Tauri v2
Build Python terminal user interfaces with the Textual framework
